engagement_background.objective: To create procurement cost savings for APDerm while ensuring business needs are fully met.
engagement_background.scope_summary: The project involved strategic sourcing across multiple categories including Medical Supplies, Employee Benefits, IT Hardware/Software, and more.

summary.headline: $1.2M or 19% in cost savings on an addressable baseline of $6.3M
summary.narrative: The Treya/AP Derm strategic sourcing project successfully delivered $1.2M or 19% in cost savings across 10 spend categories over 2 phases. Incumbent suppliers were retained in many cases, allowing APDerm to realize significant savings upon contract execution without having to deal with transition time.

evidence.quote: Total project savings of $1.2M or 19% on $6.3M in baseline spend over 2 Phases

case_study_packaging.headline: $1.2M run-rate savings across 10 categories
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: APDerm faced fragmented supply base and decentralized purchasing, resulting in not leveraging their full purchasing power.
approach_summary: Implemented strategic sourcing via RFP and negotiations
Ensured savings sustainability through transparent supplier interactions
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Delivered $1.2M in savings while retaining incumbent suppliers, minimizing transition disruption.

extraction_notes: Revenue was estimated based on web search results.
Some categories have limited data on vendors before and after.
Fee structure details were not fully available in the Agreement.
Savings estimates and actuals were closely aligned, but some categories had wide savings ranges.
